bf16_baseline: A = flat BF16, diagnostic only; A does not gate B
mixed_prefix: excluded: Issue #9 rejected it as a general solution

decision_rule.inside_ambiguity: B prediction must lie within F's ambiguity set (candidates whose F probability is within the oracle ambiguity radius of F's top-1)
decision_rule.rationale: the radius is mathematically coupled to the per-candidate probability bound: top-1 ordering can reverse only within 2*epsilon_p

suite_verdict: every valid row passes; no failure budget
reporting_requirements: exact B_vs_F argmax agreement across all 42 rows, even where ambiguity-set membership permits a different winner
fraction of holdout rows inside and outside the oracle ambiguity region
oracle decision regret p_F(top1) - p_F(pred_B) for every permitted flip
KL divergence and centered logit deltas reported, not gated

holdout.ordering: 18 synthetic rows (prefix ascending, then candidate count, then candidate units) followed by 24 semantic rows in generation order

methodology.no_posthoc_adjustment: if B fails any valid holdout row, plain shared BF16 remains unsupported on this runtime; any new execution policy requires a newly predeclared contract and a new holdout
methodology.resource_preflight: allowed before the 42-row run to establish shape feasibility; resource-only, may not inspect decision results or replace cases
methodology.infeasible_shape_rule: stop and freeze a revised manifest before seeing acceptance metrics
methodology.request_grouping: one DecisionRequest per score invocation, identical grouping across F, G, A, B
methodology.development_set_quarantine: the nine Issue #9 oracle-relative rows are the development set; no threshold may be derived from them
